final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.death_country AS c, AVG(v.points_won * 1.0 / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS a FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1) SELECT s1.c, s1.a, s1.a * 1.0 / NULLIF(s2.m, 0) FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL
